narrative.overview: The browser application uses the same trusted-device workbench language as desktop. Fumadocs and app tokens remain isolated, while browser permission and performance constraints take priority over decoration.

rules.name: App Isolation Rule
rules.body: Unprefixed tokens serve the application area; Fumadocs tokens serve documentation UI only.

dos: Request clipboard access only in a user gesture.
